tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add an exact visible catalog variant to its merchant cart. First call get_search_results with product_id and copy the product_id and variant_id exactly; never guess a size, option, seller, or unavailable variant. This adds to an existing line when present and schedules merchant Cart MCP sync, but does not begin checkout.

product_id.description: Exact product id from get_search_results in the active session.

variant_id.description: Exact available variant id returned for that product by get_search_results with product_id.

quantity.description: Number of units to add to this exact line; defaults to 1.

tools.name: create_permalink
tools.description: Construct and validate a UCP shopping permalink from a merchant-advertised HTTPS permalink endpoint and exact item identifiers. Use the endpoint from the merchant's dev.ucp.shopping.permalink capability; never invent or substitute a storefront URL. Include optional context only when the user requested it. This returns a link but does not open it, update a cart, or begin checkout.

endpoint.description: Exact HTTPS endpoint advertised in dev.ucp.shopping.permalink; no trailing slash, query, or fragment.

items.description: Exact merchant item or variant identifiers and positive quantities.
One exact merchant item and the quantity to initialize.

quantity.description: Number of this exact item to initialize, from 1 to 999.

continue_to.description: Optional safe same-origin path beginning with one slash, such as /collections/sale.

discount_codes.description: Optional discount codes explicitly requested by the user, in application order.

postal_code.description: Optional buyer postal code used to initialize merchant context.

attribution_ref.description: Optional non-sensitive attribution reference explicitly supplied by the user.

utm_source.description: Optional UTM source explicitly supplied by the user.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the shopper's current UCP Playground carts, grouped by merchant because each merchant owns a separate cart and checkout. Returns visible line items, quantities, cached prices, merchant totals, and sync state. It does not refresh stale details, change quantities, clear a cart, or begin checkout.

tools.name: get_search_results
tools.description: Read products already loaded in the active UCP Playground session. Use after search_catalog or when the user refers to a visible product. Pass product_id to return that product's exact variant ids, options, availability, price, and merchant before add_to_cart. This does not perform a network request or reveal hidden catalog data.

turn_id.description: Optional turn id returned by search_catalog or get_site_state.

product_id.description: Optional exact visible product id; when present, returns that product and up to 50 exact variants for add_to_cart.

max_results.description: Maximum number of currently loaded products to return.

tools.name: get_site_state
tools.description: Read the current UCP Playground page, active session, session history, and high-level search/cart counts. Call this first when you need to orient yourself or obtain a session_id. It does not return product results or cart lines; use get_search_results or get_cart for those.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the visible UCP Playground page. Use destination=session only with a session_id returned by get_site_state, and destination=product only with a product_id returned by get_search_results. Other destinations need no id. This changes only the visible page; it does not search, change carts, or begin checkout.

destination.description: The UCP Playground surface to open.

session_id.description: Required only when destination is session; copy it exactly from get_site_state.

product_id.description: Required only when destination is product; copy it exactly from get_search_results.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Start a text search in the Global Catalog using the UCP Playground's current filters, buyer context, language, currency, and page-size settings. Use for a shopper's product query, not for a known product id. Results arrive asynchronously: after calling, wait for completion and call get_search_results. This opens the active session and does not add anything to the cart.

query.description: Natural-language product search, for example 'waterproof trail shoes under $150'.
